brief.text: Closed-End Funds represent a recurring industry theme in cluster activity, with BPRE, SWZ, and PSUS all drawing multiple buyers, led by BPRE’s $27,045,493 total. The single largest transaction dwarfed the rest of the filings, as a 10% owner in SAFX logged $142,083,451, significantly exceeding the top cluster group total of $57,144,458 across three insiders in BORR. BYRN stands out for the broadest internal participation, drawing six distinct insiders in cluster purchases—the highest insider count on the board—alongside a separate individual $70,375 purchase by a director.
